title: Seven rail test files trigger their own rail denials on purpose; they are proofs that a rail fires, not test-quality defects
severity_rationale: S4 informational: expected behaviour of proof tests.

evidence.note: filtered to test/*/rails/ paths: 7 files. Ledger entries per file: notifier refusals; env, data, DB and network denials against fakes or loopback; net-allow to 127.0.0.1
